narrative: The repository began as the HKUDS CLI-Anything project and is retained here as a public personal fork. On 2026-07-23, the fork added an explicit branch and ownership policy so upstream synchronization could remain separate from Kombiz-owned harness work. A Buzz harness was subsequently built and reviewed on its own branch. The 2026-08-23 surface rollout added root agent authority and a structured repository chapter while preserving the rule that fork-only changes land through personal/main, never the clean upstream mirror.

entries.summary: Added evidence-backed fork authority, Repobook state, and landed-revision publishing without assigning an ambiguous registry identity.
detail: Made root AGENTS.md point to FORK_POLICY.md and preserve the main versus personal/main boundary.
Added all four Repobook files with the current upstream divergence, empty landed personal inventory, and pending Buzz integration stated explicitly.
Installed a Repobook workflow for personal/main because main is reserved for clean upstream synchronization.
Recorded the DigitalOcean Spaces CI handoff as manual-required after trusted secretctl locate was unavailable; no project UUID or secret reference was guessed.
Kept the similarly named Greymatter entry separate because it has no GitHub identity and describes a bare deployed tool collection.
